evidence.note: Authentication record sets only the Aad kind (AuthorizationUri, Resource, Scope). The token is read through Utils GetCredential (Utils.pqm 486-496), called from GetSqlEndpointNavTable at OneLakeSql.pq 232.
Control-plane REST calls (sqlEndpoints, warehouses, connectionString) go through Web.Contents via Http.Request.
The data itself is reached through Sql.Database(tdsEndPoint, database, curatedOptions).
workspace and database are declared text parameters that name the workspace and the SQL endpoint or warehouse item.
The optional options record parameter.
artifactType (Lakehouse or Warehouse) is a text selector that fits no other id, so it is other.

options-fields.text: The code reads only CommandTimeout, CreateNavigationProperties and HierarchicalNavigation, which are passed to Sql.Database. Other fields are dropped by MissingField.Ignore. The documented sample ConnectionTimeout is never read.

evidence.note: curatedOptions selects CommandTimeout, CreateNavigationProperties and HierarchicalNavigation from options.
Returned rows come from the Sql.Database driver as tables. The JSON parsed from the control-plane responses is used to locate endpoints and is not returned as data, so json is not counted.
Column names and types on returned tables come from Sql.Database. The connector assigns no M types to returned data.
moreOptions sets ManualStatusHandling from the handler keys. Status is inspected through try and errorHandler, and the handler map is consulted. Applies to token and data calls alike.
Builds Error.Record values from HTTP response bodies and status codes (lines 363-375 and 386-395).
Documentation.Name, Caption, Description and LongDescription are set.
Documentation.FieldCaption is set on each parameter (lines 138, 142, 146, 150).
Documentation.SampleValues is set on each parameter.

The navigator is built by Sql.Database, which lists schemas and tables from the server at runtime. System schemas are filtered at line 242. HierarchicalNavigation is only user-enabled, so hierarchical is not counted.
TestConnection evaluates { "OneLake.SqlAnalytics" } & ParseResourcePath(...), which names the shared entry function.

A separate OnTestConnection handler on the returned table delegates to DataSource.TestConnection(sqlAnalytics). The field-level wiring is still the entry function, so the answer is reuses-entry-function.
Table.View with an OnSelectRows handler and a GetExpression handler.
Folding is delegated to Sql.Database, which folds on its own.
OnSelectRows forwards the selector to sqlAnalytics. GetExpression returns Value.Expression(Value.Optimize(sqlAnalytics)).
Code is loaded from Utils.pqm, Table.NavigationTableView.pqm, Workspace.PrivateLink.pqm and Workspace.pqm through Extension.LoadFunction.
Strings come from Extension.LoadString, which loads localized resources.
Icons are loaded through Extension.Contents as PNG files.
Beta = true is set on the Publish record.
Diagnostics.Trace(TraceLevel.Warning, Connector.WebError) runs on the live error path with no switch.
Diagnostics.Trace(TraceLevel.Warning, WorkspacePublicAccess) runs on every call from GetSqlEndPointsTable, with no switch.
